blocks.text: جمل أطول ومفردات أقلّ شيوعًا. الكلمات الجديدة في معظمها مشروحة أدناه.

blocks.note: هل لي أن أطلب منك شيئا؟

blocks.text: Why did she ask me that?
You can ask him for help.
We have to ask after Tom.
blocks.note: علينا أن نسأل عن أحوال توم.

sentences.t: Why did you ask me?
Why do you even ask?
I'll ask Tom for you.
When did you ask Tom?
I had better ask her.
Ask him about his dog.
Don't ask me for money.
May I ask you something?
sentences.ar: هل لي أن أطلب منك شيئا؟

sentences.t: Why did she ask me that?
Can I ask you something?
You can ask him for help.
We have to ask after Tom.
sentences.ar: علينا أن نسأل عن أحوال توم.

sentences.t: Why did she ask to see me?
You have only to ask for it.
You will ask Tom, won't you?
I don't ask you for anything.
He came to ask us to help him.
May I ask where you are going?
sentences.ar: هل يمكنني أن أسأل, إلى أين أنتَ ذاهب؟

sentences.t: He came to ask us for our help.
Ask her when he will come back.
You can always ask me for help.
Ask me something about Algeria.
Let me ask you something, Ziri.
sentences.ar: دعني أطلب منك شيئا يا زيري.

sentences.t: Didn't I ask you not to do that?
sentences.ar: ألم أطلب منك عدم فعل ذلك؟

sentences.t: I'll never ask Tom for help again.
sentences.ar: لن أطلب المساعدة من توم مرة أخرى.

sentences.t: Ziri did not come to ask for money.
sentences.ar: لم يأتي زيي كي يطلب المال.

sentences.t: Why are you doing this, if I may ask?
sentences.ar: لماذا تفعل هذا إن كان لي أن أسأل؟

sentences.t: Mary doesn't know who she should ask.
sentences.ar: لا تعرف ماري من ينبغي أن تطلب منه ذلك.

sentences.t: I'll ask Tom and Mary how they did that.
sentences.ar: سوف اسأل توم و ماري كيف فعلا ذلك؟

sentences.t: I often see him.
